data.name: Bella Biochar Corp
data.description: Bella Biochar Corporation is an Ontario-based biochar producer that converts landfill-diverted waste wood into certified organic biochar using an air-curtain thermal conversion process. The company is Puro.earth CDR-certified and markets biochar for soil amendment and carbon removal credits, with a small team of ~3 employees.
